topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's strange, how the world can seem so vast, yet here we are, connected by more than just pixels and screens. I always thought that the distance made our conversations more precious, each word a bridge over the miles. Now, to know that you're closer, in the same city, it feels like the bridge I built is now a path I can walk, but I'm not sure I'm ready to leave the safety of my side. It’s a different kind of closeness, one that’s more than just a text away, and I’m finding it hard to adjust to the thought of what that means.
